newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude launches 2 Trilogy models in U.S..
newsitem.headline: St. Jude launches 2 Trilogy models in U.S..

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said it released commercially in the United States the Pacesetter Trilogy SR+ and Trilogy DC+ pacemakers.
The pacemakers join the Trilogy DR+, DR, DC and SR models to complete the Pacesetter Trilogy family of single-chamber and dual-chamber pacing systems, St. Jude said.
Pacemakers are electronic devices implanted in the body and wired to the heart to keep it beating regularly.
St. Jude is a medical device manufacturer.
